description: Header file defining the V4L2SliceVideoDecodeAccelerator class, which implements a hardware-accelerated video decoder using V4L2 slice API for media processing on Raspberry Pi 4. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures related to video decoding, buffer management, and device interaction.

classes.name: V4L2SliceVideoDecodeAccelerator
classes.description: Implements hardware-accelerated video decoding using V4L2 slice API, managing buffers, surfaces, and device interactions for Raspberry Pi 4.

classes.name: OutputRecord
classes.description: Represents output buffer information including associated video frame and texture details.

classes.name: PictureRecord
classes.description: Tracks decoded pictures with cleared status and picture metadata.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration and client.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds a bitstream buffer for decoding.

methods.name: AssignPictureBuffers
methods.description: Assigns picture buffers for decoded frames.

methods.name: ImportBufferForPicture
methods.description: Imports a GPU memory buffer for a picture buffer.

methods.name: ReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Reuses a picture buffer after display.

methods.name: TryToSetupDecodeOnSeparateSequence
methods.description: Attempts to set up decoding on a separate sequence.

methods.name: GetSupportedProfiles
methods.description: Returns supported video profiles for decoding.

methods.name: OnMemoryDump
methods.description: Provides memory dump information for profiling.
